Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 8b:1:1.hebrew: שהחדש מתכסה בו - לרחוקים, כגון שחרית לבני מערב וערבית לבני מזרח, לפי שקטנה היא סמוך לחידושה:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 8b:1:1.english: For the moon is concealed on it - For those who are far away, such as in the morning for the people of the west and in the evening for the people of the east, because it is small close to its renewal.
